preconditions.description: The length of the string s (m) and the desired length of the string (n) are within the specified bounds.
The difference between the desired length (n) and the length of the string s (m) does not exceed 2000.
The string s consists only of round brackets '(' and ')'.

postconditions.description: The number of valid pairs (p, q) is a non-negative integer less than 10^9 + 7.

postconditions.expression: all((p + s + q).count('(') == (p + s + q).count(')') and all((p + s + q)[:i].count('(') >= (p + s + q)[:i].count(')') for i in range(1, len(p + s + q) + 1)) for p in {'(', ')'}**x for q in {'(', ')'}**y if len(p + s + q) == n)
postconditions.description: The string p + s + q is a valid sequence of round brackets for all valid pairs (p, q) of lengths x and y such that the total length is n.
